references.name: newton
references.why: a scene Mike rated strong: shaded architecture, cast shadows, grounded figure

visual_review: Castle: does it stand on the ground, or float on a slab above the horizon? Look at focus crop 'castle base'.
Coaster (motion/coaster): does the car leave the track naturally, or disappear in one frame? Check the red-flagged frames.
Van (motion/van, still van-boarding): is the mouse visibly entering the van door, or hidden behind/clipped by the van?
Is there an untextured or mismatched rectangle anywhere (e.g. behind the van)? Is it art or a firmware drawing artefact?
Compared with the REFERENCE Newton scene: texture on the castle and buildings, shadows, light direction, depth. Which elements look flat?
Do the landmarks (castle, coaster, wheel, palms, house, van) read as one coherent park or as separate stickers on a flat ground?
Menu and guide stills: is the text readable at arm's length and does the overlay fit the scene?

art.note: assembled from Pixelorama tiles (tools/orlando_overnight/convert_scene.py, background-overnight2 manifest); tiled sources are not supported by review.py yet
